<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exx222024-11-01-14-39" status="unreviewed">
         <lb n="263.6"/>'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="3837">g.yor rnyan</rs> na re yod la skad cig<lb n="263.7"/> gi mi rtag pas khyab pa mngon sum gyis dngos su nges pa'i phyir 'phags par<lb n="263.8"/> thal lo zhe na rtags ma grub la | yod pa la skad cig gi mi rtag pa shugs las<lb n="263.9"/> nges pa'i phyir 'phags par thal lo zhe na khyab pa ma grub bo zhes zer ba ni<lb n="263.10"/> 'khrul ba kho na ste byas yod la skad cig gi mi rtag pas khyab pa dngos su nges<lb n="263.11"/> kyang rung shugs las nges kyang rung ste rtag par 'dzin pa dang gcig pur<lb n="263.12"/> 'dzin pa'i bdag mngon sum gyis mi khegs pas 'phags par thal ba'i nyes<lb n="263.13"/> pa gnas so zhes gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
